parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of wood, typically rectangular and attached to the front of the cabinet frame.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main access point to the cabinet interior, allowing users to open and close the storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges attached to the cabinet frame, enabling swinging motion for opening and closing.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet frame made of plywood, forming the structural body of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the door, drawers, and base, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet base made of wood, located at the bottom of the cabinet structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Drawer (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower drawer made of wood, located at the bottom section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides enclosed storage space for smaller items and slides in and out for access.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along metal or wooden rails, allowing smooth sliding motion.

parts.name: Drawer (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper drawer made of wood, positioned above the lower drawer inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space for smaller items and can be pulled out for access.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along rails, similar to the lower drawer.
